description:
Read usage events (paginated, read-only). Filter by meter, provider,
    consumer_class (internal|external|unknown), channel, outcome (ok|error),
    and ISO date range [since, until). Test-flagged events are excluded
    unless include_test=true. Returns events + next_cursor.

channel.description: Optional filter: the channel the events came through.
channel.title: Channel

consumer_class.description: Optional filter: internal, external or unknown.
consumer_class.title: Consumer Class

cursor.description: Optional. The cursor from your previous answer, to fetch the next page.
cursor.title: Cursor

include_test.description: Optional. Include events from meters flagged as test. Default false.
include_test.title: Include Test

limit.description: Optional. The most items to return.
limit.title: Limit

meter_id.description: The meter id returned by create_meter.
meter_id.title: Meter Id

outcome.description: ok or error. Feeds the SLA report.
outcome.title: Outcome

provider.description: Agent id of the party providing the service.
provider.title: Provider

since.description: Optional. ISO-8601 timestamp: only items at or after this time.
since.title: Since

until.description: Optional. ISO-8601 timestamp: only items before this time.
until.title: Until

name: list_events
title: List events
